title: 536. Encode String with Shortest Length

examples.explanation: Encoding as "3[a]" would be longer (4 vs 3), so the original string stays.
The inner block "abbbabbbc" first compresses to "2[abbb]c", and doubling it gives the shortest form.

hints: Let dp[i][j] be the shortest encoding of the slice s[i..j]: split it at every k and keep the best concatenation.
Also test whether the whole slice is a repetition of a smaller block, using the doubled-string trick to find the period.
